description: Update an existing offer code on a product (its code text and/or its max purchase count). Gumroad REST: PUT /v2/products/{product_id}/offer_codes/{id}.

id.description: The offer code id to update.

max_purchase_count.description: New cap on how many times the offer code can be used.

product_id.description: The product id the offer code belongs to.

name: gumroad_update_offer_code
title: Update offer code
